reason: The cited evidence shows kinetic effects on phase selection in a different HEA (E1) and short-range Al order in high-T BCC Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni (E2), but none directly demonstrates that Al diffusion kinetics govern phase stability in Cr39Co18Fe18Ni18Al7 or that longer annealing at 1350–1100 °C produces the claimed segregation-driven ordering; the connection to diffusion kinetics is inferred rather than supported by specific prior data.
